description.fallback: After being pulled through a hole in the floor of DIO's mansion, Joseph, Kakyoin, and Jotaro stand on a small tropical island with Telence. Joseph tries to interrogate Telence, but he refuses to answer Joseph's questions. The only way to get to DIO is by defeating Telence, so the group decides to attack him all at once.
